description: This file 'resultsReqs.php' is a PHP source file for a part of the TestLink open source test management tool. Its main purpose is to generate detailed reports of requirement-based test results, including building a requirements specification map, evaluating requirement coverage and statuses, and rendering complex HTML tables with test progress insights.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering extendable HTML tables used in the report, including configuration for column grouping, sorting, and toolbar functionalities.

methods.name: build_req_spec_description
methods.description: Creates a descriptive string for a requirement specification to display in the grouped table, summarizing requirement counts and statuses.

methods.name: evaluate_req
methods.description: Determines the evaluation status (e.g., passed, failed, uncovered) for a specific requirement based on test case counters and configured algorithms.

methods.name: setUpLabels
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves localized label strings used throughout the report for requirements, statuses, and evaluation categories.

methods.name: setUpReqStatusCfg
methods.description: Prepares configuration mappings for test result statuses and evaluation labels, including CSS classes and counting.

methods.name: buildReqSpecMap
methods.description: Constructs a mapping of requirement specifications, linking requirements with their test cases and computing coverage metrics.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions to view the test plan metrics page based on user rights stored in the database.
